reservation: SHA256 document id first eight hex digits modulo five equals zero; metadata filter before text and annotations. Original test not downloaded.
training: Allowed original train only. Teacher segmentation/POS for static arc-standard oracle states. Nonprojective examples teach segmentation/POS, not impossible arc-standard derivations. All development examples remain in denominators.
inference: Raw id/text only; model predicts boundaries, contraction expansions, POS and dependency edges. No gold words, POS, arcs, labels, documents or partition metadata reach inference.
scoring: Strict complete-word-alignment scoring: if a sentence's predicted word forms differ from gold, all its gold words count wrong for strict POS/UAS/LAS. Also report conditional alignment-only diagnostics, exact tree count, relation families and projective/nonprojective strata. Not official UD shared-task scoring. All raw predictions retained.
selection: Most strict end-to-end labeled correct attachments, then complete trees, then fewer page bytes, then policy order. Development is consumed; not final audit.
candidate_refusal: A policy exceeding existing page/residency budgets is rejected with raw logs, not silently enlarged or retuned. Other runtime errors stop the campaign. Report every policy including rejected ones.
scope: First supervised syntax experiment, not a semantic parser, pretrained LLM, autonomous architecture evolution, full M1, or authority. M1 completion contract unchanged; no M2 or production promotion. RSS and energy unavailable. Preserve CC BY-SA 4.0 corpus/derivative attribution.
